channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 25 Aug: Harare mainly clear · high 24° / low 11°
item.description: Harare: high 24°, low 11° (mainly clear) · Bulawayo: high 26°, low 11° (clear sky) · Mutare: high 24°, low 10° (clear sky) · Gweru: high 25°, low 10° (clear sky) · Masvingo: high 26°, low 11° (clear sky) · Victoria Falls: high 29°, low 15° (clear sky) Tsumo yezuva: Gudo guru peta muswe vadiki vakutye.
